name: Agonizing Blast
description: Add your Charisma modifier to one damaging Warlock cantrip's damage.

name: Armor of Shadows
description: Cast Mage Armor on yourself without spending a spell slot.

name: Ascendant Step
description: Cast Levitate on yourself without spending a spell slot.

name: Devil's Sight
description: See normally in dim light and darkness, magical or nonmagical, to 120 feet.

name: Eldritch Mind
description: Gain Advantage on Constitution saves made to maintain Concentration.

name: Eldritch Smite
description: Once per turn when your pact weapon hits, spend a Pact Magic slot for extra Force damage and possibly knock the target Prone.

name: Eldritch Spear
description: Increase the range of one damaging Warlock cantrip.

name: Fiendish Vigor
description: Cast False Life on yourself without spending a spell slot and take the spell's maximum temporary HP.

name: Gaze of Two Minds
description: Link senses with a willing Humanoid and cast spells from its space while the link is maintained.

name: Gift of the Depths
description: Gain a swim speed, breathe underwater, and cast Water Breathing once per Long Rest.

name: Investment of the Chain Master
description: Empower your pact familiar's attacks, movement, defenses, and combat commands.

name: Lessons of the First Ones
description: Gain an Origin feat for which you qualify.

name: Mask of Many Faces
description: Cast Disguise Self without spending a spell slot.

name: Master of Myriad Forms
description: Cast Alter Self on yourself without spending a spell slot.

name: Misty Visions
description: Cast Silent Image without spending a spell slot.

name: One with Shadows
description: Cast Invisibility on yourself without spending a spell slot while in dim light or darkness.

name: Otherworldly Leap
description: Cast Jump on yourself without spending a spell slot.

name: Pact of the Blade
description: Conjure or bond a pact weapon and attack with Charisma.

name: Pact of the Chain
description: Learn Find Familiar and summon additional familiar forms.

name: Pact of the Tome
description: Gain a Book of Shadows containing three cantrips and two ritual spells.

name: Repelling Blast
description: Push a Large or smaller creature up to 10 feet when one chosen attack-roll cantrip hits it.

name: Thirsting Blade
description: Attack twice instead of once when you take the Attack action with your pact weapon.
